  Scenario: AC7 A provided operation refuses a call without a valid credential or permission with 401 or 403, and an unknown id with 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a provided operation of this story
    When it is called without a valid credential, without permission, or with an unknown id
    Then it answers 401, 403 or 404 as the contract states and writes nothing

  Scenario: AC8 A replayed write with the same idempotency key is not written twice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write of this story has been accepted with an idempotency key
    When the same write is sent again with the same idempotency key
    Then no second write is made

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the check unclaimed (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed owner call fails or does not answer
    When the accepted file is handed off
    Then the state stays VALIDATED with its hand-off pending and no queue version is claimed

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a check in a state
    When a change to a state the model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused and the state is kept
